pages.heading: Enderiophage
pages.body: End Midlands. Its Ender Flu causes a dangerous delayed outbreak; remove it with Chorus Fruit or milk. Dropped Capsids transfer items upward and participate in

pages.heading: Enderiophage (cont.)
pages.body: unusual transformations. A Capsid, vertical End Rod and Eye of Ender can create another phage. Keep experiments separate from livestock and living areas.
